races.paceDynamic: Viviana will lead from the start and looks likely to get an easy time of it with no other committed pace horses in this fillies' novice. Black Orchid and Reigning Queen may press from prominent positions, but neither has shown the speed to truly challenge Viviana early. This sets up a moderate gallop that will quicken in the final two furlongs as the hold-up horses Slot and Why Because make their moves from the back. The lack of pace pressure heavily favours front-runners and prominent racers who can travel comfortably before kicking clear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Viviana Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Viviana gets a soft lead and isn't pressed through the middle stages
scenarios.body: She can dictate fractions and have enough left to repel late challengers, with prominent racers also benefiting from the steady tempo. The lack of early speed plays into the hands of those who can sit handy.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses into a sprint finish due to lack of early speed
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks over this sharp track. The race becomes a dash from the 2f pole where stamina matters less than raw speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutante Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Veil Of Clouds shows significant improvement from her breeding on this quicker surface
scenarios.body: The Crisford-trained filly could have natural speed to sit prominent and outstay rivals, benefiting from the steady gallop. Her pedigree suggests she has untapped ability on faster ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If even Viviana fails to go forward and the field crawls for four furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where previous form means nothing and any horse with a turn of foot can win. Overbudget could benefit despite poor recent form if she recaptures her early promise.

races.paceDynamic: Lily Pearl appears the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure. The prominent runners like Borjina, Seeing Stars and Come On Eibhlin will sit just behind, while the majority are hold-up horses who need to find gaps in the straight. With good to firm conditions and 14 runners, the pace should be honest but not frantic early. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early speed horses who can track Lily Pearl and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Lily Pearl maintains her lead without serious challenge through halfway
scenarios.body: She can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back, while prominent trackers also benefit from the controlled tempo and get first run on the field. The hold-up horses face a wall of runners ahead when they need racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses successfully stalk Lily Pearl and quicken approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: Borjina or Seeing Stars can time their challenge perfectly, getting the jump on both the leader and the hold-up horses who are still making ground. This becomes a battle between the first four or five off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or the early leaders weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The closers get ideal conditions to unleash their finishing kicks, with Nanoscience and Magic Box having the class to reel in tiring pace-setters. A fast pace opens up the race for late runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If Lily Pearl goes too slowly or gets headed early, creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes scrappy with multiple pace changes that suit nothing in particular, leading to an unexpected winner from midfield who gets the clearest passage. Tactical jockeying favours experience and racecraft.

watchPoints.text: Lily Pearl dictating from the front without any pressure through the first half-mile as she may prove impossible to catch

races.paceDynamic: Sovereign Bright is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate terms uncontested in the early stages. With eight hold-up horses behind him, this creates a tactical race where the pace is likely to be modest through the early stages. The lack of early pace pressure means Sovereign Bright can control fractions and potentially steal a march, while the large group of hold-up horses will be relying on a strong finish over the final 3-4 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours horses with early pace or those that can position prominently, as the bunched field of hold-up horses will face significant traffic problems in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sovereign Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to build an unassailable lead, with the hold-up brigade left with too much to do. His prominent racing style and ability to control the tempo proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace creates a cavalry charge finish with multiple improvers
scenarios.body: The bunched field creates interference and only the best-positioned hold-up horses can get clear runs. Superior class and racing room determine the outcome.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sovereign Folds Late
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright's early advantage is eroded by a strong late surge
scenarios.body: His lack of recent wins catches up as the hold-up horses mount their challenge, but only the strongest stayers prevail in the extended finish. The trip and class tell.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Sovereign Bright goes too slow and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The pedestrian early pace allows every horse to stay in contention, creating a messy finish where an unconsidered runner can emerge from the pack. Form gets turned upside down.

races.paceDynamic: Stratocracy is the sole confirmed front-runner and will likely set a comfortable, uncontested pace from the start. With 15 other runners predominantly holding back, this creates a tactical race where the pace-setters and prominent racers get first run while the hold-up horses face a wall of traffic in the straight. The lack of early pace pressure means Stratocracy and the prominent runners like Inspired, It Just Takes Time, and Empirestateofmind will dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large field of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Pace Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Stratocracy gets an easy lead without serious challenge through the early furlongs
scenarios.body: The pace-setter travels comfortably into the straight and kicks clear while the field bunches behind, creating maximum traffic for the hold-up brigade. Prominent racers get ideal splits to challenge while most of the field remains locked away.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Stratocracy early, creating moderate pace pressure
scenarios.body: The genuine pace creates a stronger gallop that suits the horses racing handily, with Inspired and It Just Takes Time perfectly positioned to strike. The hold-up horses still face traffic issues but the stronger pace brings more into play late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Shuffle
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight despite the modest pace
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses get hampered while others find clear runs through luck or jockey skill, creating an unpredictable finish. The race becomes a lottery where positioning matters more than raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Stratocracy goes too slowly early and the field remains tightly bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: The crawling pace allows the entire field to stay in contention, creating a messy sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins. Raw speed overcomes tactical positioning in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Stratocracy getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive given the lack of other pace angles
Traffic problems in the straight will be severe with 15 hold-up horses trying to find racing room
It Just Takes Time and Inspired getting good positions early as the key prominent challengers
Roaring Ralph's recent winning form being negated by his hold-up style in this pace scenario
The large field creating more interference than usual at Wetherby's tight seven-furlong configuration

races.paceDynamic: Crocus Time will lead from the gates with South Shore Island, Eldeyaar and Highfield Jewel providing prominent company in the early stages. The pace should be genuine but not destructive over this sharp 5½f trip, with multiple hold-up horses including Sir Benedict, Dragon God, Highland Bear, Mrs Trump, Amerjeet and He's An Angel settling behind. With only one confirmed front-runner in Crocus Time, the pace will be controlled rather than frenetic, allowing closers time to mount their challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late finishing kicks, as the moderate early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the final furlong dash.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady with Crocus Time unopposed early
scenarios.body: The controlled tempo allows closers to gather momentum and overwhelm the leaders in the final 100 yards. Sir Benedict, Dragon God and Mrs Trump benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If South Shore Island or Eldeyaar press Crocus Time from the outset
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses positioned handy to the pace. Eldeyaar's front-running ability and Crocus Time's recent form become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Crocus Time Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Crocus Time establishes an uncontested lead and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The penalty-carrying leader uses tactical advantage to build an unassailable advantage before closers can respond. Recent Redcar winner proves class tells despite the extra weight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Speed
scenarios.trigger: If early leaders go too slowly and sprint finish becomes crucial
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace turns this into a dash from halfway, suiting horses with natural speed over stamina. He's An Angel's AW speed and Highland Bear's fresh legs become telling assets.

Check He's An Angel's starting mannerisms as consistent slow starts could prove fatal over this sharp 5½f trip
Note Highland Bear's market moves given turf handicap debut status and potential for significant improvement

races.paceDynamic: Surgeon Commander and Ellie's de Vega will likely contest the early lead in this 5½f handicap, with both confirmed front-runners ensuring a solid gallop from the start. Their dual presence should create an honest pace that will stretch the field, preventing any tactical crawling. The sustained tempo over this sharp distance will expose any fitness doubts and reward those with tactical speed. This race shape strongly favors prominent racers and strong-finishing hold-up horses who can capitalize on the anticipated pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Surgeon Commander and Ellie's de Vega engage in a sustained battle from the start
scenarios.body: The two leaders will weaken each other through fractions that are too fast for the distance, allowing hold-up horses with tactical speed to sweep past in the final furlong. Data Fata Secutus and Powernap are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets an uncontested lead while the other fails to fire
scenarios.body: Either Surgeon Commander or Ellie's de Vega will dictate terms and prove too strong for the closers over this sharp track. The winner will have enough in reserve to resist late challenges from the pack.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing a well-positioned horse to strike
scenarios.body: Northern Tempest or Sea Her Excel will track the pace perfectly and have enough left to pass tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. This requires tactical riding and a horse hitting peak form.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise from the Back
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely due to tactical riding or non-runners among leaders
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole, suiting a horse with untapped ability stepping up significantly. Wayward Queen with top connections or an improving handicapper could shock.

watchPoints.text: Watch if either Surgeon Commander or Ellie's de Vega gets an uncontested lead as both have enough ability to exploit easy fractions
